'''Two-grain wheat''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[Mill|milled]] into [[Flour|two-grain wheat flour]] or [[Still|brewed]] into [[Alcohol|two-grain wheat beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] two-grain wheat for its ''beer''.
